entries.title: Psalms 24:1
segments: ¶<A Psalm. Of David.> The earth is the Lord's, with all its wealth; the world and all the people living in it.

entries.title: Psalms 24:2
segments: For by him it was based on the seas, and made strong on the deep rivers.

entries.title: Psalms 24:3
segments: ¶Who may go up into the hill of the Lord? and who may come into his holy place?

entries.title: Psalms 24:4
segments: He who has clean hands and a true heart; whose desire has not gone out to foolish things, who has not taken a false oath.

entries.title: Psalms 24:5
segments: He will have blessing from the Lord, and righteousness from the God of his salvation.

entries.title: Psalms 24:6
segments: This is the generation of those whose hearts are turned to you, even to your face, O God of Jacob. (Selah.)

entries.title: Psalms 24:7
segments: ¶Let your heads be lifted up, O doors; be lifted up, O you eternal doors: that the King of glory may come in.

entries.title: Psalms 24:8
segments: Who is the King of glory? The Lord of strength and power, the Lord strong in war.

entries.title: Psalms 24:9
segments: Let your heads be lifted up, O doors; let them be lifted up, O you eternal doors: that the King of glory may come in.

entries.title: Psalms 24:10
segments: Who is the King of glory? The Lord of armies, he is the King of glory. (Selah.)
